passage: Exercise is essential for a healthy body, but many people have questions about how it works. One common query is whether you need expensive gym equipment to build strength. The truth is that using your own body weight, such as doing push-ups or squats, is an excellent way to build muscle. Another question is when muscles actually grow. Many think muscles grow while you are lifting weights, but they actually grow during the rest periods after exercise when the body repairs tiny tears in the muscle fibers. Regarding fat loss, some believe that sweating is the same as burning fat. In reality, sweating is simply the body’s way of cooling down, not a direct measure of fat loss. Finally, some people worry that warming up is a waste of time. This is incorrect because warming up gradually increases your heart rate and prepares your muscles for activity, which helps prevent injuries. It is also important to keep moving gently after a workout rather than sitting down immediately, as this helps your body recover properly. Always remember that exercise is about consistency and listening to your body, not just about how much you sweat or how heavy the weights are.

items.evidence: Many think muscles grow while you are lifting weights, but they actually grow during the rest periods after exercise when the body repairs tiny tears in the muscle fibers.
items.q: Why are rest days after training useful for building bigger muscles?
options: The body repairs the muscle during rest
The muscles keep growing from the lifting itself
Resting burns the fat around the muscle
Rest lets the muscles train faster the next day
items.explain: Muscles grow in the rest periods after exercise, when the body repairs tiny tears in the fibers.

wrong.why: thinks muscles grow during the lifting itself
thinks exercise burns fat from one body part
thinks more training days means faster growth

items.evidence: The truth is that using your own body weight, such as doing push-ups or squats, is an excellent way to build muscle.
items.q: Meena has no gym nearby. What can she do to build muscle?
options: Do push-ups and squats at home
Wait until she can buy heavy weights
Use only machines made for bodybuilders
Do the same easy exercise for years
items.explain: Push-ups and squats use your own body weight, so they build muscle without gym equipment.

wrong.why: thinks heavy weights are needed for strength
thinks strength work is only for bodybuilders
thinks easy exercise keeps building muscle forever

items.evidence: In reality, sweating is simply the body’s way of cooling down, not a direct measure of fat loss.
items.q: Tara sweats a lot while running. What does this show?
options: Her body is cooling itself down
She has burned a lot of fat
Her muscles are growing bigger now
She is working harder than needed
items.explain: Sweating is the body's way of cooling down; it does not directly show how much fat is lost.

wrong.why: thinks muscle grows during exercise, shown by sweat
thinks only very tiring exercise is useful

items.evidence: It is also important to keep moving gently after a workout rather than sitting down immediately, as this helps your body recover properly.
items.q: After a hard run, Dev wants to sit down at once. What should he do instead?
options: Walk gently for a while first
Run a little faster to cool off
Skip the walk because moving tires him
items.explain: Moving gently after a workout, instead of sitting down immediately, helps the body recover properly.

wrong.why: thinks stopping suddenly is best after exercise
thinks more hard effort helps recovery
thinks more movement only tires the body
